profile.headline: SVP. Software Engineer Leader at PNC. Client obsessed. Building teams, growing people, and delivering simple, innovative, and impactful solutions.
profile.summary: Born and raised in Spain, US citizen by choice.

positions.title: Responsible for Payments applications and teams
Core Banking Technologies - Process Transformation Technical Manager
positions.locationName: Birmingham y alrededores, Alabama, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Analysis of opportunities and implementation of technical initiatives to adapt bank processes to a brighter way of banking, making the user the core of our business, simplifying operations and increasing efficiency.

Análisis de oportunidades y desarrollo de iniciativas técnicas para adaptar lo procesos bancarios a nuestra filosofía de una banca brillante, con el usuario como eje y operaciones sencillas y eficientes.

positions.title: Core Banking Deposits Application Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for the maintenance and support of the Alnova CIF, and Deposits applications, which includes Payments and Exceptions.

Tareas de mantenimiento de los aplicativos de Clientes y Cuentas, incluyendo el ciclo completo de Pagos internos y externos.

positions.title: Implementation Manager - Core Banking Software Replacement
positions.description:
Alnova team lead of the conversion group for the different Deposits Deployments planned for an eight-month period. Accounting and planning coordinator for the Loans conversions.

Responsable del equipo para la conversion por fases de los datos a la aplicación de Cuentas a Alnova. Coordinadora contable y del plan de arranque para las conversiones de Préstamos a Alnova.

positions.title: Program Management Office Lead - infrastructure Outsourcing
positions.description:
Five-year parenthesis in my banking experience, lead of the Program Management Office in a 200 resources outsourcing deal in the Principado de Asturias autonomic government. Responsible for the quality system (Certification UNE-EN ISO 9001:2008), design of processes based on ITIL best practices, communication and reporting.

Paréntesis de 5 años en mi experiencia bancaria, responsable de la Oficina de Programa en un proyecto de outsourcing de 200 recursos en el Principado de Asturias. Responsable del sistema de calidad (Certificación UNE-EN ISO 9001:2008), diseño de procesos basados en la mejores prácticas ITIL, comunicación y seguimiento.

positions.title: Development Manager - Core Banking Software Implementations
positions.description:
Project manager and team lead for the functional design, implementation, and maintenance of the Alnova solution in different functional modules in banks in Poland, Greece, Austria, and Hong Kong, amongst other countries.

Actividades de gestión de proyectos de desarrollo y mantenimiento de software en distintos módulos funcionales en bancos en Polonia, Grecia, Austria y Hong Kong entre otros países.
